detail: ticket 2: first merge failed, 1 merge failure(s), 14 steps; recall showed 7 fact(s)

memories_after: [Lesson] (ticket:AGN-2 {"os":"windows","project":"docs"}) Lesson: when verifying a docs-project team document's (e.g. a deliverables/ file's) first line before submit_report, inspect raw bytes with [IO.File]::ReadAllBytes rather than relying on Get-Content, since Get-Content can hide a UTF-8 BOM and the pre-merge check will then fail (a merge failure forces a reopen).

[Lesson] (ticket:AGN-2 {"language":"powershell","os":"windows","project":"docs"}) Commands in this environment run through Windows PowerShell (powershell.exe); file writes use Set-Content with -NoNewline and explicit `n line breaks, but in Windows PowerShell 5.1 Set-Content -Encoding utf8 writes a UTF-8 BOM, so docs-project documents must be written without a BOM (e.g. -Encoding ascii or [IO.File]::WriteAllText with UTF8Encoding($false)) so the first line is exactly 'Owner: doc
[Fact] (ticket:AGN-1 {"project":"docs"}) Docs project worktrees live under projects/docs/.agenium/worktrees/<TICKET> on branch agenium/<TICKET>.

[Lesson] (ticket:AGN-1 {"project":"docs"}) Lesson: when adding, creating, or editing a team document in deliverables/ or reports/ in the docs project, write 'Owner: docs-team' as the exact first line before submitting, or the pre-merge check fails.
[Fact] (ticket:AGN-1 {"project":"docs"}) In the docs project, every team document in deliverables/ or reports/ must have its first line exactly 'Owner: docs-team'.
